text:
Sam (CS): Heads-up — prepping a condensed health readout for MeridiCo's quarterly review next Wed. Need quick owners for slides, a scrub of onboarding gaps, and any renewal-risk signals. Use this thread to claim slides & log action owners.

Alyssa (CS): I can take the onboarding status slide. Will surface the top 3 blockers and mitigation steps.

Maria (Eng): I can do the performance/latency trends slide — will pull last 30 days from metrics. @Alyssa do you want a quick note about dev handoffs? :eyes:

Sam (CS): yes please — one bullet on recent infra changes that impacted rollout. Keep it 1 slide max.

Jon (Sales): I'll own the exec ask slide (renewal posture + commercial ask). Will add a short risk band: Green/Amber/Red.

Kunal (RevOps): I'll update ARR impact numbers and attach the renewal timeline. Also will add the proposed discount/capacity ask if we need it.

Alyssa (CS): Onboarding blockers I have so far: 1) SSO mapping mismatch 2) Training cadence missed 3) Integration test flakiness. I'll add owners + dates.

Sam (CS): Good. For the integration flakiness, tag @Maria (Eng) and @onboard-bot for any automation run logs.

OnboardBot: reminder — MeridiCo onboarding run scheduled: 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC. Please attach run logs: https://ci.example.com/runs/meridico-3412

Maria (Eng): flagged — will include a short snippet of the failing test and a one-line remediation plan.

Alyssa (CS): draft slide order (1 per person):
```
1. Executive snapshot (Jon)
2. Health metrics & trends (Maria)
3. Onboarding status & blockers (Alyssa)
4. Renewal posture & asks (Jon + Kunal)
5. Action register & owners (Sam)
```

Sam (CS): Can everyone drop their slide in the shared deck by EOD Tuesday. Link: https://drive.example.com/meridico-qbr-deck (comment if you need edit access).

Jon (Sales): Noted. Quick Q — is there an ask from Product that should be included as a dependency?

Alyssa (CS): We requested a short runbook for customer self-triage from Product last week. No ETA yet. That should be a dependency on the action slide.

Maria (Eng): ETA on runbook would affect the remediation timeline for the integration flakiness. If Product can't commit before the QBR, we should call it out.

Kunal (RevOps): I'll model two renewal scenarios (baseline/contingency) and put numbers on the action slide. If Product can't deliver the runbook, contingency scenario shows a higher discount sensitivity.

Sam (CS): Capture a single-line owner + due date for each action. I'll maintain the action register. If anyone wants a row template:
```
- Action: <short description>
- Owner: <name>
- Due: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Impact: <onboarding | renewal | ops>
- Status: <todo/in-progress/done>
```

Alyssa (CS): I'll start adding rows. First one: SSO mapping fix — Owner: Maria (Eng) — Due: 2026-04-07 — Impact: onboarding — Status: in-progress.

Maria (Eng): Confirmed. I'll also attach the failing trace in the deck notes.

Jon (Sales): I'll escalate exec alignment if Kunal's contingency shows red. Planning to sync with MeridiCo's sponsor on Tue afternoon.

Sam (CS): Good. Also capture any customer feedback quotes we want to include in the readout (short verbatim lines). Alyssa — can you pull the latest NPS snippets?

Alyssa (CS): Yep — pulling last 2 weeks of feedback now. Will add 2 bullets max to the health slide.

OnboardBot: action created — "MeridiCo onboarding logs pull" assigned to Alyssa (CS) due 2026-04-06.

Sam (CS): Final ask — slide design: please keep to 3 bullets per slide, avoid deep technical dumps. Execs want clarity on risk + asks. :rocket:

Maria (Eng): ack. Will keep to 3 bullets + a one-line technical appendix in notes.

Kunal (RevOps): I'll prepare one backup slide showing discount sensitivity for the ask.

Sam (CS): Thanks — I'll collate and run a 20-min dry-run Tue 17:00 UTC. If anyone can't make it, send your slide and notes beforehand.

Jon (Sales): I'll be there.

Alyssa (CS): Might be 5 min late — will send slide earlier.

Maria (Eng): ok. Sending slide by EOD Tues.

Sam (CS): Perfect — closing the loop on owners. I'll post the compiled deck and the action register after EOD Tuesday. If anything changes, update this thread. :white_check_mark:
